mapper.sql: family_id, owner_user_id, name, is_deleted, deleted_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO family ( family_id, owner_user_id, name, is_deleted, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{familyId, typeHandler=com.echoes.user.domain.user.repository.typehandler.BinaryUuidTypeHandler}, #{ownerUserId, typeHandler=com.echoes.user.domain.user.repository.typehandler.BinaryUuidTypeHandler}, #{name}, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM family WHERE family_id = #{familyId, typeHandler=com.echoes.user.domain.user.repository.typehandler.BinaryUuidTypeHandler} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM family WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId, typeHandler=com.echoes.user.domain.user.repository.typehandler.BinaryUuidTypeHandler} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT f.family_id, f.owner_user_id, f.name, f.is_deleted, f.deleted_at, f.create_time, f.update_time FROM family f INNER JOIN family_member fm ON f.family_id = fm.family_id WHERE fm.user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.echoes.user.domain.user.repository.typehandler.BinaryUuidTypeHandler} AND f.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT f.family_id, f.owner_user_id, f.name, f.is_deleted, f.deleted_at, f.create_time, f.update_time FROM family f LEFT JOIN family_member fm ON f.family_id = fm.family_id WHERE (f.owner_user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.echoes.user.domain.user.repository.typehandler.BinaryUuidTypeHandler} OR fm.user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.echoes.user.domain.user.repository.typehandler.BinaryUuidTypeHandler}) AND f.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE family SET name = #{name}, update_time = NOW() WHERE family_id = #{familyId, typeHandler=com.echoes.user.domain.user.repository.typehandler.BinaryUuidTypeHandler} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE family SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE family_id = #{familyId, typeHandler=com.echoes.user.domain.user.repository.typehandler.BinaryUuidTypeHandler}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM family WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId, typeHandler=com.echoes.user.domain.user.repository.typehandler.BinaryUuidTypeHandler} AND is_deleted = 0
